title: .solopreneur.json (schema version 2)
description: Path-scoped solopreneur configuration. This schema describes the v2 `.solopreneur.json` file ONLY. The legacy `solopreneur.json` feature config (the `default`/`repos` cascade documented in shared/config.md) is a different file under a different regime and is deliberately not described here. The two coexist. One file may configure several features, each in its own top-level block; every reader resolves only its own block and steps over files that lack it.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only on a breaking layout change.

preview.description: Configuration for the preview Library rooted at this path scope.

root.description: Content root holding the collections. A relative value resolves against the directory of THIS file, never against the git root or the current working directory. A leading `~` is NOT expanded.

defaultTarget.description: Key under `targets` used when no target is named explicitly.

targets.description: Deployment targets, keyed by name. The format allows several; v1 of the resolver accepts exactly one and rejects the rest, so multi-target support can arrive without a file format change.

collections.description: Local content lifecycle buckets. v1 fixes the set to `active` and `archive`; the schema stays open so a third can be added later without a format change. Staying open does not mean unvalidated — any additional collection must have the same shape as the two named ones.

path.description: Directory name under `preview.root` holding this collection's items.

label.description: Human-facing heading for this collection in the Library catalog.

provider.description: Hosting provider. Kept as an open string so a second provider does not require a format change; v1 of the resolver accepts only "vercel".

project.description: Provider-side project this target publishes to. Must be a dedicated project — publishing a Library to a project that also serves a real site would overwrite it.

projectId.description: Provider-side stable project id (Vercel's `prj_…`), written by setup after the project is created/linked so the target is bound to a specific project, not just a name. OPTIONAL and additive: a name-only config (no projectId/teamId) stays valid and is treated as the current scope. A `teamId` may appear only alongside a projectId — the resolver rejects a lone teamId.

teamId.description: Provider team/org scope the project lives under (Vercel's `team_…`, the project's `accountId` when team-owned). OPTIONAL: omitted for a personal-scope project. Only meaningful with a projectId; a name-only config storing just `project` cannot distinguish a team project from a same-named personal one, which is what this pair resolves.

visibility.description: Omitted means "private". `public` must be written explicitly and still has to clear the publish-time content review.

include.description: Collection keys published to this target, in catalog order.

signoffs.description: Configuration for the sign-offs review pages. Every key is optional; with no block anywhere, pages go to docs/solopreneur/sign-offs/ in the main working tree, in English, for 7 days. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning, so a config shared by machines on different plugin versions keeps working.

root.description: Folder for the `local` provider. A relative value resolves against the directory of THIS file and, when that lies in a linked git worktree, is moved to the same place in the main working tree so pages outlive the worktree. A leading `~` is NOT expanded. Default: docs/solopreneur/sign-offs under the main working tree.

lang.description: Language of the review UI and of the reply keywords; the first reply line is always `sign-off <id> r<revision>`. Default: en.

ttlDays.description: Days a page lives after its latest publish; every update restarts the clock. Default: 7.

replyTo.description: Where the reader pastes the reply, shown on every new page. Default: a per-language sentence.

defaultTarget.description: Key under `targets` used when no --target is given. Read only from the user config ($SOLOPRENEUR_CONFIG, else ~/.config/solopreneur/config.json); sign-offs refuses a project .solopreneur.json that sets it. Omitted: the built-in local provider.

targets.description: Publish targets, keyed by name. Read only from the user config ($SOLOPRENEUR_CONFIG, else ~/.config/solopreneur/config.json); sign-offs refuses a project .solopreneur.json that sets it.

provider.description: `local`: files under signoffs.root, opened over file://. `static`: a folder an existing web server already serves. `server`: the bundled server (install it with scripts/server.py install).

host.description: SSH destination holding `dir` (static, server). Omitted or `local`: this machine. A config shared by several machines may name the store host: on that host the publisher writes locally instead of connecting to itself.

url.description: http(s) address that serves `dir` (static, server); a page is published at <url><id>/. Use https: browsers only allow the copy button in a secure context.

dir.description: Folder holding the pages on the host: absolute, or starting with `~/` (expanded on the host). Required for static, which must not share it with other content; for server it defaults to ~/.local/share/solopreneur/sign-offs, where install puts the server.
